issues.field: documents counted as provided / repair_quote (and repair cost in EUR: 980)
issues.recorded: repair_quote.pdf counted as provided for policy VER-1003 (Ines Haddad, Toyota Yaris 2019) and used as the basis for the €980 repair cost
issues.should_be: The repair quote counted as provided must belong to this policyholder and vehicle; the quote on file is made out to Mr. Julien Roche, Renault Clio (2017), registration DX-482-KD — a different customer and a different vehicle
issues.evidence: repair_quote.pdf (Garage des Lilas, quote Q-2610-5320): 'Customer Mr. Julien Roche … Vehicle Renault Clio (2017), Registration DX-482-KD', total incl. VAT 980,00 €; Policy Schedule for VER-1003: holder Ines Haddad, vehicle Toyota Yaris (2019). Contract Article 4.3 (2630#10414, page 2) requires a repair quote for C2, and the review rule requires each provided document to belong to this policyholder and vehicle.

verdict.summary: All other facts check out (C2 in the Policy Schedule, incident 2026-10-28 reported 2026-10-29 within the 5-day deadline of Article 4.1, policyholder at fault with no third party so the €300 C2 deductible applies and the commercial-vehicle referral playbook rule is not triggered, no exclusion indicated, €980 ≤ €1,500 so no assessor per Article 6.1, photos counted as received), but the attached repair quote belongs to a different customer and vehicle (Julien Roche, Renault Clio DX-482-KD), so the €980 repair cost is not supported by a valid quote for Ines Haddad's Toyota Yaris and the payment should not be approved as staged.
